steps.eval: __rhf.start(false)

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; window.__until=async(f,ms)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const v=f(); if(v) return v; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } return f(); }; g.state.cooler.push({species:'king',weight:18.2,length:95,value:218,legend:null,name:'King Salmon'}); g.state.trophies.push({species:'caribou',name:'Caribou',weight:130,value:420}); const it=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='post'); g.player.place(it.x,it.z,0); return 'at post'})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; await __until(()=>g.interaction&&g.interaction.label==='TRADE',120000); return 'interaction '+(g.interaction&&g.interaction.label)})()
__rhf.press('interact'); 'trade'
(async()=>{ await __until(()=>document.getElementById('sell-all'),60000); return 'shop open '+!!document.getElementById('sell-all'); })()

(()=>{const b=document.getElementById('sell-all'); if(!b) return 'no sell button, open='+__rhf.game.screens.current; b.click(); const g=__rhf.game; return 'money '+g.state.money+' cooler '+g.state.cooler.length+' challenges '+Object.keys(g.state.challenges).join(',')})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close(); g.state.money=5000; g.screens.open('shop',{tab:'garage'}); return 'garage'})()

(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=buy-engine]')][0]; b.click(); const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=buy-paint]')][1]; p.click(); const g=__rhf.game; return 'engine '+g.state.gear.engine+' paint '+g.state.gear.paint+' money '+g.state.money})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close(); g.state.discovered.falls=true; g.fastTravel('falls', 0.5); return 'travel'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const f=document.getElementById('fade'); await __until(()=>f.classList.contains('on'),20000); await __until(()=>!f.classList.contains('on'),120000); return 'fade over'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('falls'); return 'car near falls '+Math.hypot(g.hotrod.pos.x-p.x,g.hotrod.pos.z-p.z).toFixed(0)+' time '+g.env.time.toFixed(2)})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const it=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='cabin'); g.player.place(it.x,it.z,0); g.env.setTime(22.5); return 'at cabin'})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; await __until(()=>g.interaction&&(g.interaction.label==='SLEEP'||g.interaction.label==='REST'),120000); return 'interaction '+(g.interaction&&g.interaction.label)})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const ia=g.interaction; if(!ia) return 'no ia'; ia.act(); return 'slept via '+ia.label})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; await __until(()=>g.env.day===2,60000); const f=document.getElementById('fade'); await __until(()=>!f.classList.contains('on'),60000); return 'woke'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; return 'time '+g.env.time.toFixed(2)+' day '+g.env.day})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.save(); const raw=localStorage.getItem('rubenHotrodFishing.save.v1'); const d=JSON.parse(raw); return 'saved money '+d.money+' engine '+d.gear.engine+' day '+d.day})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.toTitle(); return 'title '+(!document.getElementById('title').hidden)+' continue visible '+(!document.getElementById('btn-continue').hidden)})()
(()=>{__rhf.start(true); const g=__rhf.game; return 'continued money '+g.state.money+' paint '+g.state.gear.paint+' day '+g.env.day})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.player.hurt(150); return 'hurt, health '+g.player.health})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; await __until(()=>g.player.health===60,120000); const f=document.getElementById('fade'); await __until(()=>!f.classList.contains('on'),60000); return 'knocked out and back'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; return 'after KO health '+g.player.health+' money '+g.state.money+' cooler '+g.state.cooler.length})()
